newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.02 million barrels in the week ended May 2 to 315.69 million barrels, from 314.67 million the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.86 million barrels in the week to 250.38 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.68 million barrels to 97.56 million barrels from 94.89 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 403,000 barrels to 30.49 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 35,000 barrels in the week to 7.77 million bpd from 7.73 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 3.63 million barrels in the week to 190.55 million barrels from 194.18 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 94.5 percent from 93.5 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.35 million barrels to 35.47 million barrels from 34.12 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.41 million barrels from 14.28 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 41.81 million barrels from 42.28 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.11 million barrels per day from 7.98 million, API said.
